text:
alex_chen: Hi team — I'm relocating to Tokyo next month for a client onsite. Need two things: 1) official proof of recent vaccinations + TB clearance for the embassy appointment, and 2) how to file a claim for the occupational health clinic visit I did at a private clinic here (receipt in JPY). Also I added my partner as a dependent last month but didn't get a new ID card — can I get a retro electronic ID?

maria_peopleops: Hey Alex — congrats on the move! :tada: We can help with all three. Quick Q: when did you add your partner? policy change window matters for physical IDs vs. digital.

alex_chen: Added on Feb 8th (open enrollment change). Urgent: embassy appointment is in 6 days.

sasha_benefits: @alex_chen OK — for embassy docs we can generate an expedited "Coverage & Vaccination Confirmation" letter. It won't list clinical details beyond dates of coverage and vaccination entries we have on file. If you need specific vaccine lot numbers or TB test readings, you'll need the clinic's test report.

ben_hr_ops: For the electronic ID card: because the dependent was added during open enrollment window, we can issue a retro electronic ID (PDF) the same day. I can trigger it now if you confirm partner's full name and DOB.

alex_chen: Partner is "Maya Chen" DOB 1993-07-11. Yes please on the PDF.

maria_peopleops: Noted. @ben_hr_ops can you send the PDF to Alex's work email? Also Alex — for the embassy they sometimes ask for a clinician-signed vaccination record. Do you have the clinic report?

alex_chen: I have the receipt and a one-page stamp saying TB negative, but it's in Japanese. Receipt is a PDF for ¥8,200.

sasha_benefits: For claims in JPY: we accept the original receipt plus an English translation (can be a short free-form translation) and the bank/card statement showing payment. Please upload all three to the benefits portal under "Out-of-country medical claims." The portal has an "upload foreign currency" checkbox so claims team knows to convert.

claims_bot: Reminder: Out-of-country claim processing can take 10–15 business days after we receive complete docs. Missing translation or payment proof will delay it.

alex_chen: Is there a code I should ask the clinic to put on the receipt? This was an occupational health visit (pre-employment/return-to-work TB test + vaccine booster).

sasha_benefits: If they can add a short line like "Occupational health: TB screen + Hepatitis A booster" that's helpful. For coding: CPT isn't required for us, but if the clinic knows ICD/CPT please include. Otherwise a clear description + itemized cost is fine.

maria_peopleops: For the embassy letter — Sasha can draft it but if you need clinical specifics (e.g., vaccine lot or TB Quantiferon value) you'll need to get that from the clinic and upload the scanned report. If time is tight, we can issue a general coverage/vax confirmation PDF that many consulates accept.

ben_hr_ops: Alex, I'll send the retro electronic dependent ID to your email within the hour. If you need a printed copy for the clinic, that PDF works.

alex_chen: Thank you — huge help. One more: is the vaccine cost typically reimbursable under preventive vs. medical?

sasha_benefits: Good Q. If it was an employer-required occupational vaccine/test (client requirement), it's reimbursable as medical/occupational. If it was elective travel vaccine, it may fall under preventive and be subject to preventive coverage rules. We'll classify based on the clinic note you upload.

alex_chen: Got it. Uploading docs now.

maria_peopleops: Great — once you upload, tag @sasha_benefits in the claim message and we'll flag it for expedited review due to embassy timeline. If anything's missing we'll DM you.

alex_chen: Uploaded: receipt.pdf, tb_report_jp.pdf, payment_statement.png. Tagged Sasha.

claims_bot: Claim #OC-2026-492 assigned. Please allow up to 3 business days for expedited triage, then standard processing timeline.

sasha_benefits: I see the upload. Thanks — I'll mark it expedited. Alex, can you ask the clinic for a one-line English translation of the TB report? If they can't provide it today, we can accept a short free-form translation you paste in a message.

alex_chen: I'll request it now and update if they send. Appreciate everyone. :bow:
